setup_expired_restart_replacement_with_y: Setup expired. Restart replacement with your password and a fresh code from your current authenticator.
setup_expired_sign_out_and_request_a_fre: Setup expired. Sign out and request a fresh enrollment grant, or sign in with another unused recovery code.
the_result_could_not_be_confirmed_resume: The result could not be confirmed. Resume setup to check this sign-in before trying another proof.
the_result_could_not_be_confirmed_sign_o: The result could not be confirmed. Sign out and sign in with your new authenticator if you confirmed replacement, then generate new recovery codes using your password and a fresh authenticator code.
keep_these_ten_one_use_codes_somewhere_p: Keep these ten one-use codes somewhere private, separate from this device. They are shown only now.
if_this_response_is_lost_sign_in_with_yo: If this response is lost, sign in with your authenticator and generate new recovery codes under Authenticator security.
add_an_account_in_your_authenticator_app: Add an account in your authenticator app using this setup key. Choose time-based codes, six digits, and a 30-second period.
setup_lasts_up_to_ten_minutes_and_ends_s: Setup lasts up to ten minutes and ends sooner if your session expires. If your session expires, ask for a new enrollment grant or sign in and use an unused recovery code. If confirmation was interrupted, try signing in with this authenticator.
use_your_password_and_a_fresh_authentica: Use your password and a fresh authenticator code to replace your authenticator or generate a new set of recovery codes. Other sessions end when recovery codes change.
enter_one_unused_recovery_code_your_old_: Enter one unused recovery code. Your old authenticator will stop working and you will set up a replacement before opening records.
open_your_authenticator_app_and_enter_it: Open your authenticator app and enter its current six-digit code.
your_hospital_must_verify_your_identity_: Your hospital must verify your identity separately and give you a one-use enrollment grant. A password alone cannot open records.
replacement_setup_could_not_be_loaded_si: Replacement setup could not be loaded. Sign out, sign in again, and use another unused recovery code, or contact your account manager.
the_new_passwords_do_not_match: The new passwords do not match.
password_change_could_not_be_confirmed: Password change could not be confirmed.
replace_your_temporary_password_before_a: Replace your temporary password before accessing the workspace.
choose_a_private_password_for_your_staff: Choose a private password for your staff account.
use_at_least_12_characters_changing_your: Use at least 12 characters. Changing your password signs out all your sessions.
the_response_was_lost_retry_with_the_sam: The response was lost. Retry with the same details, or sign out and try your new password. If it was saved, the previous session has already ended.
